description: This file defines a 'Trash' class for managing trashed notes and notebooks in the Notesnook project, including cache management, cleanup, add, delete, restore, and grouping functionalities.

classes.name: Trash
classes.description: Class for managing trashed notes and notebooks, including cache, cleanup, add, delete, restore, and grouping functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Trash instance by building the cache.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of trashed notes and notebooks from the database.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up expired trash items based on deletion date and configured interval.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds notes or notebooks to the trash.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified notes or notebooks permanently.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Internal method to delete notes and notebooks in chunks.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores notes or notebooks from trash.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all trashed items, optionally filtered by 'deletedBy'.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns total count of trashed notes and notebooks.

methods.name: grouped
methods.description: Returns grouped trashed items based on provided options.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in cache.

methods.name: subNotebooks
methods.description: Fetches sub-notebooks for given notebook IDs.
